blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

Streets, schools and getting around Elgin Chantrell Guide

items.t: It is one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock", inside the City of Surrey's South Surrey community.
The guide page states both in-area schools are in the Elgin Park Secondary family for 2026–27 (site copy).

Transit: TransLink's published timetable for Route 352 (Bridgeport Station / Ocean Park) routes it via 152 St, 16 Ave, 128 St, Crescent Rd and King George Blvd through South Surrey Park & Ride — the Crescent Road corridor through this pocket is a TransLink bus corridor. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Parks and heritage: Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, 2598 144 Street — a 140-hectare park of second-growth forest with about four kilometres of nature trails, at the sub-area's eastern edge; Elgin Heritage Park and the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road are City-designated heritage entries (Bylaws 7823 and 12922) on the Nicomekl River, and the City's coming Nicomekl Riverfront Park will run 3 km on the river's south side from Elgin Road to 40 Avenue.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Elgin Chantrell Guide

items.t: SSMUH, suites and coach houses (Surrey-wide): up to 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; one secondary suite per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, never inside a coach house or garden suite, its habitable floor area at most 40% of the principal dwelling unit (no 90 m² cap is current); a coach house or garden suite of 35–75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 below maximum FAR, with one extra parking space required.

ALR housing frame: any parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve follows the ALC frame — one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha). ALR status is a parcel-by-parcel check in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder.

blocks.text: Good to know about Elgin Chantrell Guide

items.t: The name is a listing label, not a legal boundary. There is no single City boundary or plan for "Elgin Chantrell," and the board's street-level line is member-only — compare a listing against the actual street and parcel, not the label. The guide page's history (site copy compiled from the City and BC Geographical Names per the page) dates farming here to 1879, the Elgin name to 1885, and Crescent Road's route to a road first cut in 1883.

In the guide page's main FAQ section, the question "Which schools serve Elgin Chantrell?" appears with NO answer; the answer appears only in a second, separate FAQ block lower on the page. No wrong-email instance is documented on this page either (stated explicitly in the flag block above).

Heritage is a constraint here, not just character. Elgin Heritage Park and the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road are City-designated heritage entries — a property near the Crescent Road heritage cluster needs its heritage status checked before renovation or subdivision plans are priced.
Well and septic pointers are carried, not verified.
The RA numbers in older copy are not settled. The coach-house figures that do apply to RA lots (35–75 m², up to 120 m²) are confirmed on the City's coach houses page.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Elgin Chantrell Townhomes

items.t: Zoning is under Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. Much of Elgin Chantrell is Rural Residential (RA) zoning with ALR parcels at the edges.

Wells and septic: RA/ALR parcels in this area can sit on private well and septic systems rather than City water and sewer — a servicing check (well records, septic permits, and whether City services reach the lot) is part of ordinary diligence on the area's acreage stock, and any specific property's servicing is UNCONFIRMED until its records are pulled (City of Surrey, building and servicing information

Secondary suites in Surrey are capped at 40% of the principal dwelling's habitable floor area (City of Surrey, secondary suites: Inside a strata townhouse, the strata's bylaws govern whether a suite is possible at all.

SSMUH: Surrey implemented the provincial small-scale multi-unit housing rules on July 8, 2024 — up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², up to 4 units on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop (City of Surrey, SSMUH: SSMUH applies to eligible single-family lots, not to lots inside an existing strata townhouse complex, and ALR parcels are governed by the ALR rules first.
Short-term rentals: Surrey permits short-term rentals only in the operator's own principal residence, with a City business licence at $358/year as stated on the City's licence page.
Property tax timing: Surrey property taxes are due July 2; a 5% penalty applies to amounts unpaid after July 2 and a further 5% after September 2 (City of Surrey, property taxes

New Housing Rebate (GST/HST): Separate from the first-time buyer rebate: a 36% rebate of the GST on new or substantially renovated housing, to a maximum of $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000 of value (Canada Revenue Agency

PTT exemptions: First-time home buyers: full exemption on the first $500,000 of value where the fair market value is $835,000 or less, phasing out to $860,000. Newly built homes: full exemption up to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000 (BC Government, PTT exemptions

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 13 condos and townhomes listed in Elgin Chantrell. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Elgin Chantrell had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Elgin Chantrell from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 8 condos and townhomes sold in Elgin Chantrell over those 4 months, out of 375 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Elgin Chantrell sell for?
faq.a: 10 townhomes sold in Elgin Chantrell between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,242,500.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is there an apartment condo building in Elgin Chantrell?
Is Elgin Pointe a condo or a townhouse complex?
faq.a: A townhouse complex — listings record sub-type Row / Townhouse at 14655 32 Avenue, in a gated duplex-style executive townhome form. Compare and insure it as townhouse strata, and confirm fees and rules on the Form B.

faq.q: Can I rent out an Elgin Pointe unit if an old listing said no rentals?
faq.a: Long-term, yes — every BC strata rental-restriction bylaw became void on November 24, 2022, whatever older listing or bylaw text says. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw, and Surrey requires an owner-host with a business licence.

faq.q: Why did the attached shelf show no sales in September 2026?
faq.a: No cause is stated in the source, and none is invented here.

faq.q: Which school serves an Elgin Chantrell home?
faq.a: UNVERIFIED for any specific address. Chantrell Creek Elementary and Elgin Park Secondary are confirmed by name and address inside the pocket, but SD36 catchments are address-based and no locator result here is on record — run the exact address in the district locator.

faq.q: Is The Crescent strata or freehold non-strata? One listing says non-strata.

faq.a: 123.1–123.2: with May 1, 2023 exemptions for caregivers and specified family members. Read the exact bylaw wording on the Form B — complexes vary on who counts as an occupant.

faq.q: What does the Form B tell me before I buy?
faq.a: The monthly strata fee, anything the seller owes the strata, approved special levies, the CRF balance, insurance details, the strata's rules, its budget and financial statement, any Rental Disclosure Statement, and the depreciation report attached — provided within seven days of request for a capped fee of $35 plus up to 25 cents per page (Strata Property Act, s. 59
